source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 24 May 1952, p. 6 ("Four contests in Fermanagh Local Government elections")
source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'There will be no contests for Enniskillen Rural Council'; the Anti-Partitionist nominations print 'Holywell—John Regan (P. J. Timoney)' (page image read 7 Nov 2026)

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Enniskillen rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. There were no contests and three changes of personnel. No nomination was received for Doagh, whose sitting member was automatically re-elected. The Fermanagh Herald prints the nominations. In place of P. J. Timoney. Returned unopposed.
